name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.setting.view.ResetPayPasswordActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the forgotten-payment-password recovery form. It verifies the phone with an image code and SMS code before resetting the password.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from recovering a forgotten payment password.
